title: 第2517章 末日系统五54第2516章 末日系统五53
content_zh:
韩紫枫大手一挥，土特产就它了。马小玲好歹是有灵力的，所以他身上要的是魔法物品，紫枫则从里到外定了好几套，顺便算上马叮当的，还有女娲的，反正钱算将臣出的。
他们算是风风光光的，狂扫一大堆的魔法物品，才坐飞机返回嘉嘉大厦。路途中，马小玲也发现况国华的不对，作为孙子的况天佑，自然也发现况国华的不对。所以在回到嘉嘉大厦后，他们就开始揭露况国华的身份。
况国华一点没否认不说，锅也直接丢给了马丹娜。三方对案后，大体情况是：马丹娜叫况国华去打将臣，结果，况国华和况复生被咬了。
马小玲听完那叫一个气，严重声讨姑婆的不负责行为。可是一点实际效果都没有，他们总不能跟一个鬼过不去是吧。
可现在的问题，命运看着还是感觉眼前一黑又一黑，三个僵尸王，他也敢不敢好吧，何况还有远程等狙击的复习，他正常也要面临四个僵尸王，两个女娲，想想就不是人干的活。
现在整个嘉嘉大厦中，最不舒服的是阿呆，没办法，现在嘉嘉大厦都是强人啊！马小玲这次根本都没废话，就把阿呆给收到幸运星中，不过，几个僵尸看着明显是上辈子如来样子的阿呆，紫枫直接出声说：“别往下送，找个地方封印吧，这个送下去还要被踢上来。”
马小玲能说什么？安排。反正也不费什么劲，阿呆也没什么勇气，四处乱跑。相对的，嘉嘉大厦的阮梦梦，还是比较受嘉嘉大厦里邻居的喜欢的。
紫枫直接叫况家三人，就跟着阮梦梦，毕竟，堂本静就是个神经病。在没意外的情况下，况天佑就能解决，可况国华和况复生闲着也是闲着，就跟着一起去呗。
紫枫想想，还叫将臣把黄子也叫过来，一起跟着阮梦梦，如果这样阮梦梦都死了，那就真的是她时运不济啦。黄子本身就是嫉妒，既然知道有立功的机会，那怎么能放过呢？看着后面的一群人，阮梦梦都无语了，这群人是想干啥？
阮梦梦还是决定参选千禧洋紫荆小姐选美大赛，等递交表格回家途中，还是看到一女子，以祷告的形态，尸体跪在街角处。发现了尸体后，一群人能说啥？办案就完事啦。黄子很是无语的问：“你就说是谁干的不是就完了？”
紫枫回答：“堂本静。日东集团的那个，别说你不知道。”
黄子和况天佑点头，这个他们真认识，也真知道。况天佑问：“他是僵尸？”
紫枫回答：“不，蓝大力三个家伙没咬他前，他就是个爱装僵尸的神经病。被咬了就变梦魔啦。”
说真的，听到这个说法，况天佑和黄子都挺无语的。紫枫冲着跟上来的况国华和况复生说：“现在的目标就是，看着堂本静，别把阮梦梦给祸害了，并且最好有图有真相。”
确定好他们要做的事情，也就开始处理这个事情，阮梦梦的报名表，还是丑照的那个样子，但就这样，依旧是按着命运的安排，依旧进入到说洋紫荆小姐的选拔中。
这边有马小玲帮忙，第二场面试的时候，阮梦梦已经有了美女的样子，至少从里到外看着，不是那么像给洋紫荆小姐添堵的啦。
相对电影中的不太靠谱的情节，正规的选美赛还是挺靠谱的。由于知道是堂本静不靠谱，几个警察也就盯着堂本静作点啥。黄子更是带着一队警察，去扫日东集团，堂本静的房间。
在顺利找到陶瓷牙后，堂本静也就基本能算是定罪啦。加上黄子的暗中操作，洋紫荆小姐虽然还在继续进行着，可堂本静已经被带入到警局，等待后续审判。当然，更多的是，等待后续赎人，都是钱啊。
果然，堂本静还是花钱就被赎了出去，虽然是重金赎出去的，可黄子是什么人，是五色使者，能吃这个亏？明显是不能啊。于是，黄子更尽心尽责的蹲堂本静，大不了就把人薅秃了算拉倒。
黄子开始持续蹲堂本静，堂本静也一天天的，主打不干正经事，就洋紫荆小姐这几天，他几乎天天都换好几个人，所以吧，警局快成堂本静的家了，一次次被当众抓住，警局的人反正是挺开心的，不为别的，光赎人的钱就不是一比小数目，开心，开心。

紫枫跟着看热闹，都看的老无语了，将臣都忍不住吐槽：“不是，人类都这么玩的吗？”紫枫摊摊手，表示看的也挺无语。只是后门发生的事情，叫大家更加无语，不知道堂本静哪根筋不对，他居然认为是况天佑找他茬，更是主打况天佑和况国华傻傻的分不清楚。
这里就导致一个关键失误，那就是况国华这个僵尸，是扛得住热武器的，但况天佑是真不行啊，就这样，况天佑居然被车撞死了。
况国华虽然跟着，却也因为事情发生的有点快，完全没反应过来，等反应过来，人已经断气了，况国华就很气，怎么说呢，就感觉自己孙子死的，是有些什么不对劲在身上。
紫枫吐槽：“这是命运强行挽尊？”
将臣也忍不住拍脑袋，说真的他也感觉是命运强行挽尊的感觉，紫枫知道况国华很生气，直接跟末日系统约了个包年，报出皇极经世书的下落，叫不开心的况国华，和远程联系伏羲，对那个破书，进行一次打击。
知道任务的伏羲也是挺无语的，但他完全能理解况国华的不爽。可现在，这边还有个要添乱的蓝大力，紫枫本着看热闹不嫌事大的原则，挑唆马叮当去找蓝大力的麻烦，毕竟坏事他都有份的货，不给点教育不太好，顺便看看马叮当这个马家女人，到底有多少能力。
别说，马叮当一出手，连将臣都有点惊：“不是，她啥时候这么强了？”
紫枫看着将臣问：“你给开小灶了？”将臣无语，他没有啊。

content_en:
Han Zifeng waved his hand, and that was the souvenir. Ma Xiaoling had spiritual power after all, so what he wanted were magic items. Zifeng ordered several sets from inside to outside, including Ma Dingdang's and Nuwa's. Anyway, the generals paid for it.
They were in a good mood, and they swept away a lot of magic items before taking a plane back to Jiajia Building. On the way, Ma Xiaoling also discovered something was wrong with Kuang Guohua. As his grandson, Kuang Tianyou naturally also discovered something was wrong with Kuang Guohua. So after returning to Jiajia Building, they began to reveal Kuang Guohua's identity.
Kuang Guohua did not deny or say anything, and the blame was directly thrown to Ma Danna. After the three parties discussed the case, the general situation was: Ma Danna asked Kuang Guohua to fight the generals, but as a result, Kuang Guohua and Kuang Fusheng were bitten.
After hearing that, Ma Xiaoling became angry and severely denounced her aunt's irresponsible behavior. But it has no practical effect at all. They can't live with a ghost, right?
But the problem now is that Destiny still feels like his eyes are going dark again and again. Does he dare to have three zombie kings? Not to mention the review of long-range sniping. Normally, he would have to face four zombie kings and two Nuwa. Think about it, this is not a job for humans.
Now in the entire Jiajia Building, the most uncomfortable person is Dumb. There is nothing we can do, now Jiajia Building is full of strong people! Ma Xiaoling didn't waste any time this time and gave Ah-Dai the lucky star. However, when several zombies looked at Ah-Dai who looked like a Tathagata in his previous life, Zifeng directly said: "Don't send it down, find a place to seal it. If you send this down, you will be kicked up."
What can Ma Xiaoling say? arrange. It didn’t take much effort anyway, and Dumb didn’t have the courage to run around. In contrast, Ruan Mengmeng from Jiajia Building is still more popular with the neighbors in Jiajia Building.
Zifeng directly called the three Kuang family members and followed Ruan Mengmeng. After all, Tang Benjing was a psychopath. If there are no accidents, Kuang Tianyou can solve it, but Kuang Guohua and Kuang Fusheng are idle, so they can just go with them.
Zifeng thought about it and asked the general to call Huang Zi over and follow Ruan Mengmeng together. If Ruan Mengmeng died like this, it would really be bad luck for her. Huang Zi himself was jealous. Since he knew there was an opportunity to make meritorious deeds, how could he let it go? Looking at the group of people behind, Ruan Mengmeng was speechless. What did this group of people want to do?
Ruan Mengmeng decided to participate in the Miss Millennium Bauhinia Beauty Contest. On the way home after submitting the form, she still saw a woman's body kneeling on the street corner in the form of prayer. What can a group of people say after a body is discovered? The case is done. Huang Zi asked speechlessly: "You can just say who did it and that's the end of it?"
Zifeng replied: "Domoto Shizu. The one from Nitto Group, don't say you don't know."
Huang Zi and Kuang Tianyou nodded. They really knew this and knew it. Kuang Tianyou asked: "Is he a zombie?"
Zifeng replied: "No, before Lan Dali and the three guys bit him, he was a lunatic who loved to pretend to be a zombie. If he was bitten, he would turn into a dream monster."
To be honest, Kuang Tianyou and Huang Zi were speechless when they heard this statement. Zifeng said to Kuang Guohua and Kuang Fusheng who were following him: "The goal now is to watch Tang Benjing and not harm Ruan Mengmeng, and it is best to have a picture and the truth."
After deciding what they wanted to do, they started to deal with it. Ruan Mengmeng's registration form still looked like the ugly photo, but just like that, according to fate, she still entered the selection of Miss Bauhinia Bauhinia.
With Ma Xiaoling's help here, during the second interview, Ruan Mengmeng already looked like a beauty. At least from the inside out, she didn't look like she was troubling Miss Bauhinia Bauhinia.
Compared with the unreliable plot in the movie, the formal beauty pageant is quite reliable. Since they knew that Dom Benjing was unreliable, several policemen kept an eye on Dom Benjing and did something. Huang Zi even led a team of policemen toScan Nitto Group, Domoto Shizu's room.
After successfully finding the ceramic teeth, Domoto Shizu was basically convicted. Coupled with Huang Zi's secret operation, although Miss Bauhinia Bauhinia is still going on, Domoto Jing has been taken to the police station to await subsequent trial. Of course, the more important thing is that waiting for the subsequent redemption is all money.
Sure enough, Domoto Jing was redeemed with money. Although it was a large sum of money, who was Huang Zi? He was the messenger of five colors and could suffer such a loss? Obviously it can't be done. Therefore, Huang Zi worked more diligently to stay quiet, and in the worst case, he would make the person bald and knock him down.
Huang Zi began to continue squatting in Tong Benjing, and Tong Benjing also worked day by day. He mainly did not do serious things. In the past few days, as for Ms. Bauhinia Bauhinia, he changed several people almost every day. So, the police station was almost becoming Tong Benjing's home. He was caught in public again and again. The people in the police station were very happy anyway. If not for other reasons, the money to redeem people was not a small amount. Happy, happy.
Zifeng watched the fun and was speechless. The generals couldn't help but complain: "Isn't that how humans play?" Zifeng spread his hands, saying that he was also speechless. But what happened at the back door made everyone even more speechless. I don't know what was wrong with Domoto Jing. He actually thought it was Kuang Tianyou who was picking on him, and the main characters Kuang Tianyou and Kuang Guohua were so stupid that they couldn't tell the difference.
This leads to a key mistake, that is, Kuang Guohua, a zombie, can withstand hot weapons, but Kuang Tianyou really can't. In this way, Kuang Tianyou was hit by a car and died.
Although Kuang Guohua followed, he didn't react at all because things happened a bit fast. When he reacted, the person had already passed away. Kuang Guohua was very angry. How should I put it, he felt that something was wrong with his grandson's death.
Zifeng complained: "Is this fate forcing me to regain my respect?"
The general couldn't help but slap his head. To be honest, he also felt that fate was forcibly redeeming him. Zifeng knew that Kuang Guohua was very angry, so he directly made an appointment with the Doomsday System to report the whereabouts of the Huangji Jingshi Book. He told the unhappy Kuang Guohua and contacted Fuxi remotely to attack the broken book.
Fuxi, who knew the mission, was quite speechless, but he could completely understand Kuang Guohua's displeasure. But now, there is Lan Dali who wants to cause trouble. In line with the principle of watching the excitement and not taking it too seriously, Zifeng instigates Ma Dingdang to trouble Lan Dali. After all, he is responsible for all bad things, so it is not good if he does not give him some education. By the way, let's take a look at how much ability Ma Dingdang, a Ma family woman, has.
Not to mention, when Ma Dingdang took action, even the generals were a little surprised: "No, when did she become so strong?"
Zifeng looked at the general and asked, "Did you turn on the small stove?" The general was speechless, he didn't.
